lines.3: 「We can't leave the beach dirty. I may not look it, but I'm strict about ero issues.」
lines.5: Heizo was preparing the boat to leave.
lines.10: With that, Heizo started the boat while we were still ashore.
lines.11: 「Hey, Heizo! We aren't on board yet!」
lines.12: 「That is the point! You lot are staying there!」
lines.13: 「I give you an important trial: survive on that island for two days!」
lines.14: 「I will return for you Sunday night!」
lines.16: 「Indeed. This is banishment to an island.」
lines.17: 「You possess great ability but lack cooperation. Learn the importance of group living here!」
lines.20: 「How tyrannical. How can I conquer the world by conforming to ordinary people?」
lines.22: 「This is no time to stay calm!」
lines.23: 「I will personally contact your parents and families. Do not worry about that!」
lines.24: 「In that case, adieu, losers. I'll inherit all your money and waste every cent.」
lines.25: 「Crab! When did you get on the boat!?」
lines.26: 「Eheheh. It's all up here. My brilliant brain.」
lines.28: 「Ahaha, look at that frustrated face. Wonderful!」
lines.31: He seized her by the scruff...
lines.34: and hurled her in an arc toward the sea.
lines.39: 「There's a small boat here. We can escape in it.」
lines.45: 「Incredible. He destroyed it with his aura.」
lines.49: Perfectly serious, Otome began collecting the boat fragments floating ashore.
lines.51: Heizo's cruiser receded into the distance.
lines.52: We watched it in stunned silence.
lines.53: 「Only one of us can survive, then...」
lines.55: 「No! We just have to survive as a group.」
lines.56: 「Still, abandoning students on a deserted island...」
lines.57: 「It is fine. We can simply swim home.」
lines.59: 「None of us has that kind of stamina.」
lines.61: 「Nobody but you can do that, Otome.」
lines.63: 「Please think a little more realistically. We have everyone here.」
lines.64: 「Th-The Princess lectured me about common sense...」
lines.66: 「What are we going to do for water?」
lines.67: 「There was plenty in the changing hut.」
lines.68: 「So he stocked water because actually letting us die would be a problem.」
lines.69: 「Grr, that Heizo! He dumped a lady into the sea!」
lines.70: Crab climbed out of the water.
lines.72: 「Well, lamenting and struggling won't help. We may as well enjoy the situation.」
lines.73: 「Right. Let's work together and do our best.」
lines.74: 「Hear that, Crab? Cooperation. Don't drag us down.」
lines.75: 「Don't you get homesick, you freaky shark-man.」
lines.77: 「I've meant to say this forever: Samesuga is hard to pronounce. Change it to something basic like Suzuki!」
lines.78: 「Don't call it basic! You'll offend every Suzuki in Japan!」
lines.80: 「There is a natural hot spring a short climb from here.」
lines.83: 「I cannot sleep with a different pillow. I even brought my own when training in the mountains.」
lines.84: 「I don't know what you expect me to do about that.」
lines.85: 「Without rice, I cannot even eat rice balls...」
